patch_description: Following the recommendation: after the RTS pass, apply a bidirectional one-pole smoother with stronger (moderate) alpha on the full sequence, plus a short zero-phase Savitzky-Golay polish, then slice. Both are applied in forward-then-reversed / symmetric fashion, so added group delay cancels — directly attacking slope_changes (36) and false_reversals (26.6) while lag (0.32) has headroom. Alpha range shifted lower (0.5–0.65 per recommendation) and SG window sized as window_size//4, order 2, which suppresses residual ripple without flattening genuine trends.
